78.translation: Therefore, with the intention ‘you should abandon anxiety about kingdom and the rest for your sons,’ he says ‘where.’ On the side of whichever persons—the Pāṇḍavas—the Lord of Yoga, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, is present, and where Pārtha, bearer of the Gāṇḍīva bow, is present, there alone is Śrī, royal fortune; there alone is victory; there alone is prosperity, ever-increasing advancement; there alone is policy, right conduct, firm and certain. ‘There’ is to be connected throughout. Thus is my thought, my certainty. Therefore even now, you together with your sons should take refuge in Śrī Kṛṣṇa, propitiate the Pāṇḍavas, offer everything to them, and preserve the lives of your sons. This is the intention. ‘For one endowed with devotion to the Blessed Lord, through knowledge of the Self arising from His grace, release from bondage would easily occur’: this is the summary of the meaning of the Gītā.
word_for_word: ataḥ tvam putrāṇāṃ rājya-ādi-śaṅkāṃ parityaja iti āśayena āha — yatra iti
therefore, with the intention ‘you should abandon anxiety about kingdom and the rest for your sons,’ he says ‘where’
yatra yeṣāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ pakṣe yogeśvaraḥ śrī-kṛṣṇaḥ vartate
on the side of whichever persons—the Pāṇḍavas—the Lord of Yoga, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, is present
yatra ca pārthaḥ gāṇḍīva-dhanur-dharaḥ
and where Pārtha, bearer of the Gāṇḍīva bow, is present
tatra eva śrīḥ rājya-lakṣmīḥ
there alone is Śrī, royal fortune
tatra eva ca vijayaḥ
there alone is victory
tatra eva ca bhūtiḥ uttara-uttara-abhivṛddhiḥ ca
there alone is prosperity, ever-increasing advancement
tatra eva nītiḥ nayaḥ api dhruvā niścitā
there alone is policy, right conduct, firm and certain
iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate
‘there’ is to be connected throughout
iti mama matiḥ niścayaḥ
thus is my thought, my certainty
ataḥ idānīm api tāvat sa-putraḥ tvam śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇam upetya
therefore even now, you together with your sons should take refuge in Śrī Kṛṣṇa
pāṇḍavān prasādya sarvasvaṃ ca tebhyaḥ nivedya
propitiate the Pāṇḍavas and offer everything to them
putra-prāṇa-rakṣaṇaṃ kuru iti bhāvaḥ
preserve the lives of your sons: this is the intention
bhagavad-bhakti-yuktasya tat-prasāda-ātma-bodhataḥ
for one endowed with devotion to the Blessed Lord, through knowledge of the Self arising from His grace
sukhaṃ bandha-vimuktiḥ syāt iti gītārtha-saṃgrahaḥ
release from bondage would easily occur: this is the summary of the meaning of the Gītā
